name: Dowel Hip Hinge
instructions: Stand with your feet hip width apart. Hold a dowel or broomstick along your back, one hand behind your neck and the other at your lower back.
Make sure the dowel touches the back of your head, your upper back and your tailbone.
With a slight bend in your knees, push your hips back and lean your torso forward. Keep all three points of contact on the dowel.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings or when the dowel starts to leave one of the contact points.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall again.
